message.content:
**altavista.com** most commonly refers to **AltaVista**, the former web search engine that launched in December 1995 and later became defunct; its domain was redirected to Yahoo Search in 2013.[1]

A few useful details:
- AltaVista was one of the earliest major search engines and was notable for having a searchable full-text index of the web.[1]
- The original domain **altavista.com** was acquired by Compaq in 1998, and the site was later owned by Yahoo.[1]
- If you meant the current website at that domain, the historical AltaVista service no longer exists in its original form.[1]

There is also a separate site using a similar name, **altavistasearchengine.com**, which is unrelated to the original AltaVista search engine.[2]
